common.useDefault: Leave empty to use the default text.

errors.forbidden: Only an admin can do this. Ask an admin if you need access.
errors.unavailable: The server is not set up for this yet (missing service key). Try again later.
errors.not_set_up: This part is still being set up. Run the latest CAD Champions migration, then try again.
errors.invalid: Some fields are not valid. Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find this item. It may have been deleted. Reload the page.
errors.conflict: That value is already used. Choose another one.
errors.error: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.

notSetUp.title: Being set up
notSetUp.body: This section needs the latest CAD Champions migration. Once it runs, this page fills in.

emails.title: Email templates
emails.purpose: See every email CAD Champions sends, exactly as a student gets it, and send a test to yourself.
emails.help: Each email is built from sample data, so names, amounts and links are made up. Open a preview to see the email and its plain-text version. Press Send test to me to get it in your own inbox. Tests go only to your address.

auth.title: Sign-up and password emails live in Supabase
auth.body: The confirm sign-up, magic link and reset password emails are not sent by this app. They are templates you paste into the Supabase dashboard (steps in docs/cad-champions/AUTH_EMAILS.md). The files are:

payment_reserved.title: Place reserved
payment_reserved.when: Sent when a student reserves a plan. Has the Fawran transfer details and the 48-hour deadline.

payment_proof_received.title: Transfer proof received
payment_proof_received.when: Sent when a student uploads the confirmation of their transfer.

payment_approved.title: Payment confirmed
payment_approved.when: Sent when you approve a payment. Says what is unlocked and where to start.

payment_rejected.title: Transfer not confirmed
payment_rejected.when: Sent when you reject a proof, with your reason.

payment_expired.title: Reservation expired
payment_expired.when: Sent when a reservation passes 48 hours without a transfer.

payment_reminder_7d.title: Training ends in 7 days
payment_reminder_7d.when: Reminder sent 7 days before an enrollment ends.

payment_reminder_1d.title: Training ends tomorrow
payment_reminder_1d.when: Reminder sent 1 day before an enrollment ends.

payment_owner_alert.title: New payment proof (to you)
payment_owner_alert.when: Sent to the owner when a student uploads a proof, with a link to the payments queue.

answer_grade_query.title: Trainer answered a result question
answer_grade_query.when: Sent when a trainer answers a question about a test result.

answer_lesson.title: Trainer answered a lesson question
answer_lesson.when: Sent when a trainer answers a question asked on a lesson.

results_ready.title: Results ready
results_ready.when: Sent when a test is scored. Says the score may change if a trainer still has to confirm the drawing.

results_final.title: Final score confirmed
results_final.when: Sent after a trainer reviews the drawing, with the final score and any change.

weekly_progress.title: Weekly progress
weekly_progress.when: Sent once a week to students who train. Has a link to stop these emails.

announcement.title: Announcement (example)
announcement.when: The layout of an email you send from Operations. Your own text goes in the body.

actions.testSent: Test sent to {email}. Check your inbox.
actions.testFailed: The test email could not be sent.
actions.rateLimited: You sent several tests in a row. Wait a minute and try again.

errors.noEmail: Your account has no email address.
errors.render: This preview could not be built. Try again.

view.subject: Subject line
view.sampleNote: Sample data: names, amounts and links are made up.

exercises.title: Exercises
exercises.purpose: Create and publish training exercises: brief, files, answer data, marking and hints.
exercises.help: An exercise belongs to one level of a training module. Students upload one file and get feedback at once; hints unlock one per failed try.
exercises.emptyBody: Create the first exercise from a drawing PDF and an answer STEP.
exercises.newPurpose: Fill in the basics and create it. Then add the drawing, the answer STEP and the marking.
exercises.newHelp: Quick path: 1. Choose the level, titles and brief, then Create. 2. Upload the drawing PDF under Files for students and save. 3. Upload the answer STEP and save it as reference. 4. Add the 4 STEP checks. 5. Publish.
exercises.noLevelsBody: Exercises sit inside a level. Add modules and levels under Lessons first.
exercises.editPurpose: Edit the exercise, its answer data and marking. Publishing is blocked until nothing is missing.
exercises.editHelp: Upload the answer STEP to build reference data, then use "Grade a sample" to check the tolerances before you publish.
exercises.markingPurpose: What the student's file is checked against and how the points are given.
exercises.levelHint: The training module and level this exercise belongs to.
exercises.slugHint: Small letters, numbers and dashes. Used in the web address.
exercises.sortHint: Lower numbers come first in the level.
exercises.videoHint: Bunny video ID. Unlocks after a pass or 5 tries.
exercises.hintsHelp: Students get one more hint after each failed try, in this order.
exercises.hintsHint: Up to 10. Explain the idea, never the answer.
exercises.freeSampleHint: Students without a plan can try it.
exercises.createdBody: Now add the drawing, the answer STEP and the marking. It stays a draft until you publish it.

getReady.title: Get Ready content
getReady.purpose: Edit the text and intro videos students see on the Get Ready page. Leave a field empty to keep the default.
getReady.help: Each box shows the default text above it. What you type replaces the default for that language on the live page after you save. Empty box = default text. Keep any placeholders in curly brackets and any tags in angle brackets exactly as they are.

groups.software: Step 3: Software tabs (Inventor, Fusion, SOLIDWORKS, other)

videos.title: Intro videos
videos.subtitle: One video id per slot, used for both languages

editor.problems: Fix the highlighted fields before saving ({count}).
editor.videoPlaceholder: youtube:abcdefghijk or a Bunny video id
editor.videoHelp: Paste youtube: plus the 11-character id, or a Bunny Stream video id. Empty uses the default.
editor.badVideo: Use youtube: followed by the 11-character id, or a Bunny video id (a GUID).
editor.badMessage: Keep the same curly-bracket placeholders and angle-bracket tags as the default text.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.purpose: Edit the words and short definitions students see when they tap a dotted term.
glossary.help: The default text comes from the code. What you type here replaces it for that language everywhere the term appears. Empty = default. Entries with a blue Edited tag already have your text.

health.title: Content health
health.purpose: Everything that is incomplete, with a direct link to fix it. Work through the list from the top.
health.help: The page checks text in both languages, lesson videos, grading set-up, unpublished help articles and TODO-MO placeholders. Fix an item, then reload the page to see it disappear.

allGood.title: Nothing to fix
allGood.body: Every item we check is complete. Nice work.

loadFailed.title: We could not run the check
loadFailed.body: Reload the page in a minute. If it keeps happening, check the server logs.

missing_text.title: Missing English or Arabic text
missing_text.hint: One language is empty while the other has text. Students in the empty language see a blank space.

lesson_no_video.title: Lessons without a video
lesson_no_video.hint: No video is set for any software or language.

no_reference_data.title: Auto-graded work without reference data
no_reference_data.hint: The grader has nothing to compare the student's file with. Upload the answer STEP and save it as the reference.

no_rubric.title: Drawing work without a rubric
no_rubric.hint: The AI drawing check needs a rubric with at least one item.

no_rubric_aspects.title: Drawing rubrics that are not linked to marking
no_rubric_aspects.hint: The rubric has items but no marking aspects came from it, so no points are awarded. Open the rubric editor and save it again.

help_unpublished.title: Unpublished help articles
help_unpublished.hint: Students cannot find these articles until you publish them.

todo_content.title: Placeholders in saved content
todo_content.hint: A TODO-MO note is still inside text that students can read.

todo_message.title: Placeholders on public pages
todo_message.hint: A TODO-MO note is still inside page text. The owner has to supply the real information.

health.noEditor: Change it in the message files, or ask the developer.

help.title: Help Center
help.purpose: Write and manage the help articles students read, see how helpful they are, and find out what people searched for and did not find.
help.help: Students only see published articles. The helpful percentage comes from the Was this helpful buttons at the bottom of each article. Searches with no results show what to write next.

stats.title: Was this helpful?
stats.none: Nobody has voted yet. Votes appear here as students answer at the bottom of an article.
stats.note: Counted over all time, across every article. Articles with a low percentage are the best ones to rewrite.

list.emptyBody: Create the first article. It starts as a draft until you publish it.
list.caption: Help articles with their helpful votes
list.visibleNote: The Help Center updates within a minute.
list.deleteConsequence: The article disappears from the Help Center for good, and links to it stop working. This cannot be undone. Unpublish it instead if you only want to hide it.

noResults.title: Searches with no results
noResults.purpose: What people searched for in the last {days} days and found nothing. The most searched come first. These are the articles worth writing.
noResults.emptyBody: Every search in the last 30 days found at least one article, or nobody has searched yet.

form.purposeNew: Write a new help article in English and Arabic.
form.purposeEdit: Edit the article in English and Arabic. Saving updates the Help Center within a minute.
form.help: Write in Markdown. Headings, lists, bold text, links, tables and quotes are supported. The preview shows how the article will look.
form.savedBody: The Help Center updates within a minute.
form.createdBody: You can keep editing it here.
form.needsBody: An article needs both an English and an Arabic body before it can be published.
form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. It is the end of the article link, so changing it breaks old links.
form.sortHint: Smaller numbers come first inside a category.
form.publishedHint: Visible in the Help Center and in search.
form.title: Title
form.bodyHint: Both languages are needed to publish.
form.relatedSlugsHint: Addresses of other articles, separated by commas or new lines. Up to 8.
form.videoHint: Optional. A Bunny video ID or youtube: followed by the 11-character YouTube ID.
form.noVotes: No helpful votes on this article yet.
form.votes: {yes} yes and {no} no. {percent}% found it helpful.

home.title: Today
home.purpose: What is waiting for you right now. Open a card to deal with it.
home.help: Counts refresh every time you open the page. Instructors see drawings and questions; admins see everything.
home.unknown: We couldn't count this right now. Open the section to check.
home.oldestUnderHour: Oldest has waited under an hour.

drawings.title: Drawings to review
drawings.text: Drawings and manual tasks that need a trainer's decision.

questions.title: Student questions
questions.text: Lesson questions and grade queries without an answer.

payments.title: Payments to approve
payments.text: Fawran transfers with a proof uploaded.

deletions.title: Account deletion requests
deletions.text: Students who asked us to delete their account.

integrity.title: Integrity flags
integrity.text: Quiet flags such as the same file twice or a very fast test.

health.title: Content health
health.text: Missing text, videos, reference data or rubrics.

insights.title: Insights
insights.purpose: See how students move through CAD Champions, where they get stuck and how well grading works. This is your evidence for the organizers.
insights.help: Weeks start on Monday (Qatar time). Counts cover students who signed up on the chosen dates. Nothing on this page shows a student's contact details.

range.label: Date range
range.pilotHelp: An anonymous summary you can print or save as PDF. It has no names, emails or phone numbers.

partial.title: Some sections could not be loaded
partial.body: The rest of the page is fine. Try again in a minute; if it keeps happening, check the server logs.

insights.empty: No data for these dates yet.

funnel.title: Sign-up funnel by week
funnel.purpose: Students grouped by the week they signed up. Each step counts the students who reached it.
funnel.stepHelp: Steps are not forced in order: a student may watch the free lesson before taking a test. Drop-off compares each step with the one before it.

stops.title: Where students stop in Get Ready
stops.purpose: For students who have not finished Get Ready: the first required step they have not done.
stops.stuck: {count} students have not finished Get Ready.
stops.empty: Nobody is stuck in Get Ready for these dates.

skills.title: Skills
skills.purpose: Average score per skill area across diagnostic attempts. The weakest skill is highlighted.
skills.empty: No graded diagnostic attempts for these dates yet.

modules.title: Readiness per competition module
modules.purpose: How ready students are for each of the four competition modules (M1 to M4), from points earned out of points available.
modules.empty: No graded attempts with module marks for these dates yet.

improvement.title: Improvement
improvement.purpose: Students with two or more graded attempts: first score compared with the latest.
improvement.empty: No student has two graded attempts for these dates yet.

people.title: Who took part
people.purpose: Students who signed up on these dates, by study level and by institution.

grading.title: Grading health
grading.purpose: How the automatic grader, the AI drawing check and the trainers are doing.
grading.autoGradedHelp: Grader runs that finished without an error.
grading.aiSince: Since {date}. The cost is an estimate in US dollars.
grading.errorsPurpose: The codes students hit most. Each links to the Help Center article that explains the fix, so you know which articles matter most.
grading.errorsEmpty: No grader errors for these dates.

report.title: CAD Champions pilot report
report.subtitle: An anonymous summary of how the training pilot is going. It contains no names, emails or phone numbers.
report.institutionsNote: Institutions are shown as counts only, never by name.
report.htmlNote: This page is ready to print. Use Print and choose Save as PDF.

landing.title: Landing page
landing.purpose: Edit the FAQ and the testimonials on the public CAD Champions page.
landing.help: FAQ: change the question or answer in either language, or hide an item. Testimonials: the section appears on the page only while at least one is published.
landing.faqIntro: Open a question to change its text or hide it from the page.
landing.testimonialsIntro: Add only real quotes you have permission to use. Nothing shows on the page until you publish one.
landing.policiesIntro: The privacy, terms and refund pages show a DRAFT banner until you approve them here.
landing.policiesApprovedHint: Tick only after the owner and a legal reviewer approved the privacy, terms and refund texts and every missing [TODO-MO] item is filled. This removes the DRAFT banner.

fields.question: Question
fields.hideHint: Hidden items disappear from the FAQ list and from the page data.

testimonials.created: Added as a draft. Publish it when ready.
testimonials.deleteConsequence: The quote from {name} is removed for good. This cannot be undone.
testimonials.needBoth: Quote and name are needed in English and Arabic.

empty.title: No testimonials yet
empty.body: Add one to show a section on the landing page.

fields.name: Name
fields.roleHint: For example the school or university.

lessons.title: Lessons and levels
lessons.purpose: The whole training course in one tree: modules, levels and lessons, with what is published. Open a module, level or lesson to edit it.
lessons.help: Students only see published modules, levels and lessons. A lesson also needs its level and module to be published. Switch Free preview on to let people who have not enrolled watch that lesson.

tree.emptyBody: The training course has not been added to the database yet. Run the training seed migration, then reload this page.
tree.noModules: This course has no modules yet.
tree.noLevels: This module has no levels yet.
tree.noLessons: No lessons in this level yet.

list.title: Lessons in this level
list.emptyBody: Add the first lesson for this level. It starts as a draft, so students do not see it until you publish it.
list.newHint: After you create it, you land on the lesson page to add videos, notes and files.
list.createdBody: It is a draft. Fill it in, then publish it.
list.deleteConsequence: The lesson, its videos, notes and files list are removed for good, and so is every student progress record on it. This cannot be undone. Unpublish it instead if you only want to hide it.
list.exercisesNote: This level also has {count} exercises. They are edited on the exercises page.

toggles.studentsNote: Students see the change within a minute.
toggles.freeNote: People who have not enrolled can now watch this lesson.

module.title: Edit module
module.purpose: Titles, description and settings of one training module.
module.help: The module address (slug) cannot change because student links and the training pages use it.
module.savedBody: Students see the change within a minute.
module.skillAreaHint: Leave empty for the orientation module.
module.iconHint: A Lucide icon name, for example Box.
module.orientationHint: Always open to everyone, enrolled or not.
module.publishedHint: Students can only see published modules.
module.whyItMattersHint: One or two sentences that tell a student why this module is worth their time.

level.title: Edit level
level.purpose: Titles, goal and unlock rule of one level, and its lessons.
level.help: The unlock rule decides when a student can open the level. Previous level passed uses the pass mark you set here.
level.savedBody: Students see the change within a minute.
level.numberHint: 0 to 6. Each number can be used once per module.
level.unlockHint: When can a student open this level?
level.passMarkHint: The best score needed on the previous level.
level.publishedHint: Students can only see published levels.
level.willPublish: Saving will publish this level. The change is written to the audit log.
level.willUnpublish: Saving will hide this level from students. The change is written to the audit log.
level.goalHint: Complete the sentence: by the end of this level you can...

lesson.purpose: Everything about one lesson: text, videos for each software track, notes, files and settings.
lesson.help: Videos, notes and files are only shown to enrolled students, free-preview viewers and staff. Save before you preview a video, because the preview plays the saved value.
lesson.savedBody: Students see the change within a minute.
lesson.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Changing it changes the lesson link.
lesson.sortHint: Smaller numbers come first. Use the arrows on the level page to reorder.
lesson.freePreviewHint: People who have not enrolled can watch this lesson.
lesson.publishedHint: Students can only see published lessons.
lesson.freeNotPublished: Free preview only works once the lesson is published.
lesson.title: Title
lesson.notesHint: Markdown. The preview shows exactly how students will read it.
lesson.videosHint: One video per software track and language. Use the Software neutral pair for lessons that do not depend on a program. Paste a Bunny video ID or youtube: followed by the 11-character YouTube ID.
lesson.downloadsHint: Files students can download with the lesson.
lesson.glossaryHint: Terms the lesson explains. Students see them as tooltips.
lesson.trackNotesHint: For lessons that teach an Inventor-only tool. Say what Fusion and SOLIDWORKS students should do instead.

video.invalid: Not a valid ID. Use a Bunny video ID, or youtube: followed by 11 characters.
video.saveFirst: Save the lesson first. The preview plays the saved ID.
video.nothingToPreview: Enter and save a valid video ID to preview it.

errors.signed_out: You are signed out. Sign in again to preview.
errors.forbidden: This account cannot play the video.
errors.not_found: The lesson was not found. Save it and try again.
errors.no_video: The saved value does not point to a playable video.
errors.not_configured: Video playback is not set up on the server yet (Bunny keys are missing).
errors.error: The preview could not load. Try again in a moment.

downloads.label: Label students see
downloads.full: A lesson can have up to {max} downloads.
downloads.saveHint: The file is uploaded now but only attached to the lesson when you press Save.

trackNotes.bothRequired: Write the note in English and Arabic.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.purpose: Send one email to a group of students, in Arabic and English. Check the preview, send yourself a test, then send.
announcements.help: Pick who gets the email with the same filters as the Students page. A marketing email goes only to students who agreed to news. An essential email (about their account, schedule or safety) goes to everyone who matches. Students with a deletion request or no email address are always skipped.

compose.heading: New announcement
compose.help: Write the subject and the message in both languages. Use a blank line between paragraphs, "- " for a list, **bold** for emphasis and [text](https://link) for a link.

kindHelp.marketing: News, offers and new cohorts. Only students who agreed to receive news get it.
kindHelp.essential: Account, schedule or safety information. Sent even without marketing consent. Do not use it for offers.

compose.subject: Subject
compose.bodyHint: Plain text. Blank line = new paragraph. "- " starts a list item. **bold**. [text](https://link).
compose.recipientsHint: Same filters as the Students page. Leave all empty to include every student.

filters.stuckHint: Not finished 7 days after signing up.

count.skipped: Skipped: {noEmail} without a valid email, {deletion} with a deletion request, {noConsent} without marketing consent.

preview.heading: Preview
preview.subject: Subject line
preview.note: Arabic comes first, then English. The email has no personal details, so everyone gets the same message.

actions.testHint: The test goes to {email} only. It does not count as a send.
actions.testSent: Test sent to {email}. Check your inbox.
actions.testFailed: The test email could not be sent.
actions.fillAll: Fill in the subject and message in English and Arabic first.
actions.noEmail: Your account has no email address.
actions.confirmBodyMarketing: This emails {count} students who agreed to receive news. It cannot be undone once the emails are sent. You can stop and continue later.
actions.confirmBodyEssential: This emails {count} students, including those who did not agree to marketing, so use it only for account, schedule or safety information. It cannot be undone once the emails are sent.

progress.title: Sending
progress.noKey: Email sending is not set up (no sending key). Nothing was sent. Add the key, then press Continue sending in the history below.
progress.error: Sending stopped because of an error. Press Continue sending in the history below to try again.
progress.paused: Paused. Press Continue sending in the history below to send the rest.

errors.noRecipients: No student matches these filters, so nothing can be sent.

empty.title: No announcements yet
empty.body: When you send one, it appears here with how many emails were sent and how many failed.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.purpose: See who changed what and when: prices, approvals, deletions and other admin actions.
audit.help: Every important admin action leaves a row here. Filter by the start of the action name (for example payment.), the type of record, the person, or a date range in Qatar time. A changed value shows as old value, then new value.

empty.title: Nothing in the log
empty.body: Actions such as approving a payment or changing a price will appear here.
empty.filtered: No log rows match these filters. Try a wider date range or clear the filters.

deletions.title: Deletion requests
deletions.purpose: Students can ask us to delete their account. Approve or reject each request here.
deletions.help: Approving blanks the student's name, email, phone, birth date and guardian details, deletes their private notes, question text and payment details, and deletes their uploaded files. Scores stay, with no name, for statistics. Rejecting keeps the account and tells you why in the log.

gap.title: The sign-in account is not deleted
gap.body: Approving anonymises the student's data and deletes their files, but the sign-in account itself (the Supabase login) stays. If the student asked for it to be removed completely, delete that login in Supabase after approving.

empty.title: No pending requests
empty.body: When a student asks to delete their account, the request appears here.

approve.confirmBody: This blanks their personal details, deletes their notes and uploaded files (drawings and payment proofs) and cannot be undone. Their scores stay without a name. The sign-in account is not deleted.

reject.noteHint: Saved in the log. The student's account stays as it is.
reject.noteRequired: Write a short reason before rejecting.

result.partial: Account anonymised. {deleted} files deleted, but some files remain. Press Delete remaining files to try again.

plans.title: Plans, coupons and cohorts
plans.purpose: Set what students can buy, what it costs, which discount codes work and when each in-person cohort runs.
plans.help: Plans are the training packages on the join and checkout pages. A plan with no price shows "Price coming soon" and cannot be bought. Every price change is saved in the audit log with the old and new price. Coupons give a percent or fixed discount on the plan. Cohorts are the in-person groups; seats taken include paid students and reservations still being paid.

codes.slug: use lowercase letters, numbers and single dashes, for example spring-2027
codes.same_count: needs the same number of lines in English and Arabic
codes.percent_max: a percent discount cannot be above 100
codes.code: use 3 to 32 letters, numbers, dashes or underscores
codes.unknown: contains a plan that does not exist
codes.before_start: cannot be before the start date
codes.below_taken: cannot be lower than the seats already taken

fields.slugHint: Letters, numbers and dashes. Cannot be changed later.
fields.name: Name
fields.includesHint: One item per line. English and Arabic need the same number of lines.
fields.priceHint: Leave empty to show "Price coming soon" and block checkout.
fields.durationHint: How long a student keeps access after paying.
fields.durationKit: A kit has no access length.
fields.activeHint: Turn off to hide the plan.
fields.codeHint: Letters, numbers, dashes. Saved in capitals.
fields.valueFixedHint: Amount in QAR taken off the plan price.
fields.expiresHint: Works through the end of this day (Qatar time). Leave empty for no end.
fields.plansHint: Tick none to allow every plan.

plans.heading: Plans and prices
plans.intro: These are the packages students can buy. Changing a price affects new reservations only; existing ones keep the price they were given.
plans.saved: Plan saved. The join and checkout pages are updated.

kindHelp.online_in_person: Online plus a seat in an in-person cohort.
kindHelp.kit: An optional add-on students can add at checkout.

empty.title: No plans yet
empty.body: Add the first plan so students have something to buy.

confirmPrice.title: Change the price?
confirmPrice.body: {plan}: from {from} to {to}. New reservations use the new price. Reservations already made keep theirs. The change is saved in the audit log.

coupons.heading: Coupons
coupons.intro: A student types a code at checkout to get a discount on the plan. You cannot change how many times a code was used.
coupons.usedReadOnly: Used {used} times so far. This number is set by payments and cannot be edited.
coupons.activeHint: Turn off to stop the code working without deleting it.

empty.title: No coupons yet
empty.body: Add a code to give a discount to a student or an institution.

cohorts.heading: Cohorts
cohorts.intro: In-person groups. Students of an in-person plan pick one at checkout. A seat counts as taken when a student has paid or has a reservation still waiting for payment.
cohorts.statusHint: Only open cohorts can be picked. Draft cohorts are hidden.
cohorts.seatsTaken: {taken} seats taken or held now. You cannot go below that.

empty.title: No cohorts yet
empty.body: Add a cohort when you plan an in-person group.

students.title: Students
students.purpose: Everyone who signed up for CAD Champions: progress, latest result, enrollment and anything that needs a look.
students.help: Filter and sort the list, then open a student for their profile, journey, attempts, payments, questions, integrity flags and private trainer notes.
students.helpCsv: Export CSV downloads the rows that match your filters. Email and phone are included only for students who agreed to marketing emails.

filters.stuck: Stuck in Get Ready for more than 7 days

empty.title: No students yet
empty.body: Students appear here after they sign up and finish their profile.

noMatch.title: No students match these filters
noMatch.body: Change or clear the filters to see more students.

loadError.title: We couldn't load the students
loadError.body: Something went wrong on our side. Reload the page in a moment.

detail.purpose: Everything about this student in one place. Notes on this page are private to trainers.
detail.help: Read the profile and journey first. Results open the student's own results page. Admin actions are at the bottom and are written to the audit log.

journey.emptyBody: Dates appear here as the student moves through sign-up, Get Ready, tests and training.

attempts.emptyBody: Attempts appear here once the student starts a test.

exercises.emptyBody: Each exercise the student uploads appears here with their best score.

payments.emptyBody: Payments appear here when the student checks out. You can also add days with Extend enrollment below.

questions.emptyBody: Lesson questions and grade queries from this student appear here.

flags.help: Quiet checks we run on uploads, such as the same file as another student or an upload within a minute of the start. A flag is a reason to look, not proof. Students never see them.
flags.emptyBody: Nothing unusual was found in this student's uploads.
flags.confirmBody: The flag stays in the history with your name and today's date. It no longer counts as open.
flags.resolvedBody: It no longer counts on the admin home.

notes.placeholder: What did you notice? What should the next trainer know?
notes.private: Only trainers and admins can see notes.
notes.savedBody: Other trainers will see it on this page.

actions.help: Only admins see these. Each one is written to the audit log with your name.
actions.unlockText: Opens one training level for this student, even if they haven't passed the level before it.
actions.noLevels: There are no training levels yet.
actions.unlockConfirmBody: {level} opens for this student right away. There is no button to lock it again.
actions.unlockedBody: {level} is open for the student now.
actions.bypassStateOn: On: the student may start tests without finishing Get Ready.
actions.bypassStateOff: Off: the student must finish Get Ready before the diagnostic test.
actions.bypassOnConfirm: The student can start tests without finishing Get Ready. Use this for students who already know the upload steps.
actions.bypassOffConfirm: The student must finish Get Ready again before starting a test, unless it is already done.
actions.bypassOnBody: The student can start the test now.
actions.extendText: Adds days to the student's active enrollment. With no active enrollment, it creates one from today.
actions.extendConfirmBody: Adds {days} days. The enrollment now ends {from} and will end {to}.
actions.createConfirmBody: Creates an admin enrollment for {days} days, from today until {to}. No payment is recorded.
actions.enrollmentEnds: It ends {date}. The student keeps training access until then.
actions.verifyStateConfirmed: The email is already confirmed. Nothing to send.
actions.verifyStateUnconfirmed: The student hasn't confirmed their email yet.
actions.verifyStateUnknown: We couldn't check the email status. You can still try to send it.
actions.verifyNoEmail: This account has no email address.
actions.verifyNote: The link confirms the email. If they open it on another device, they may need to sign in once with their password.
actions.verifySentBody: Ask the student to check their inbox and spam folder.
actions.verifyAlready: The email is already confirmed. Nothing was sent.
actions.verifyRateLimited: Too many emails were sent to this address. Try again in about an hour.

inPerson.title: In-person session
inPerson.purpose: Start a package test for a group in the studio. Everyone's timer starts at the same moment.
inPerson.help: Choose a test that uses one results ZIP (published or admin-only), tick the students in the room and start. Each student gets a normal attempt marked in person. Students with a test in progress, in the retake wait, or without Get Ready done are skipped and listed. Integrity checks still run but expect shared studio networks.
inPerson.testHint: Only tests that take one results ZIP are listed.
inPerson.noTests: Publish or mark as admin-only a test that uses one results ZIP, then come back.
inPerson.noTasks: This test has no tasks yet, so it can't start. Add tasks first.
inPerson.m4Body: This test has a reverse engineering task. At 2:00 each student's timer shows "Physical part collected" and records the time. When you collect the parts, press "Record part collected" below so the time is saved for everyone.
inPerson.pickText: Tick each student taking the test now. You can search by name, email or institution.
inPerson.confirmBody: {count} students start "{test}" now. Their {minutes}-minute timer starts at once and can't be paused.
inPerson.confirmBodyUntimed: {count} students start "{test}" now. This test has no time limit.
inPerson.startedManyBody: They can open the test on their screens now.
inPerson.noneStarted: Check the reasons in the list on this page.
inPerson.noSessionsBody: Sessions you start for this test appear here with each student's status.
inPerson.partConfirmTitle: Record that the parts are collected?
inPerson.partConfirmBody: Saves the current time as "Physical part collected" for {count} running attempts. This can't be changed later.
inPerson.partRecordedBody: The time is saved on each attempt.
inPerson.oneText: Starts a package test for this student only, marked in person. The timer starts right away.
inPerson.confirmOneTitle: Start the test for this student?
inPerson.confirmOneBody: "{test}" starts now for this student and the timer can't be paused.
inPerson.startedOneBody: The student can open it on their screen now.

skip.in_progress: already has this test in progress
skip.cooldown: is still in the retake wait
skip.get_ready: hasn't finished Get Ready (turn on the bypass on their page if needed)

detail.not_package: This test doesn't use one results ZIP.
detail.no_tasks: This test has no tasks yet.

tests.title: Tests
tests.purpose: Build and publish tests: tasks, files, points, answer data and marking.
tests.help: A test is a set of tasks students do in one sitting. Students see only published tests. Mock tests and the qualifier usually take one ZIP of the Results folder (module package).

list.caption: All tests with their tasks, points and marking split
list.emptyBody: Create the first test, then add its tasks and marking.

create.title: New test
create.purpose: Give the test a name and a type. You add tasks, timing and rules on the next page.
create.help: The slug is the test's web address and cannot change later. Use small letters, numbers and dashes, for example mock-m1-2027.
create.slugHint: Small letters, numbers and dashes. It cannot be changed later.
create.typeHint: Diagnostic and practice tests use one file per task; mocks and the qualifier usually use a module package.
create.doneBody: Now add its tasks. It stays a draft until you publish it.

editor.purpose: Edit the test, its tasks and marking. Publishing is blocked until nothing is missing.
editor.help: 1. Set the timing and rules. 2. Add tasks with their files and points. 3. For STEP tasks, upload the answer file to build reference data. 4. Add marking aspects. 5. Publish.
editor.splitHelp: Measurement aspects are right or wrong. Judgement aspects are scored 0-3 by a trainer. Competitions give most marks to measurement, so keep judgement at 20% or less.
editor.tasksPurpose: Students see the tasks in this order. Open a task to edit it and its marking.

settings.savedBody: Students see the change the next time they open the test.
settings.timeHint: Minutes. Leave empty for no time limit.
settings.graceHint: Seconds after the time runs out to finish uploading.
settings.cooldownHint: Days before a student may take it again. 0 = no wait.
settings.uploadModeHelp: One file per task: each task has its own upload. Module package: one ZIP of the competition Results folder for the whole test, checked against the expected files below.
settings.adminOnlyHint: Only staff can see and take it, even when published.
settings.introHint: Shown before the test starts. Markdown: # heading, - list, **bold**.
settings.rulesHint: The rules students must agree to before starting.

uploadModes.module_packageHint: Mock competitions and the qualifier: the Results folder as one ZIP.

fields.title: Title
fields.judgement_method: Judgement aspects are marked by the trainer
fields.auto_check_key: An auto-checked aspect needs a STEP check
fields.unknown_folder: the folder is not one of the eight Results folders
fields.no_folder: start with a Results folder, for example Parts and Assemblies/
fields.no_name: add a file name after the folder
fields.bad_chars: the name has characters that are not allowed

task.createdBody: Now add its files, answer data and marking.
task.skillHint: One of the 6 official skill areas.
task.moduleHint: Leave as none if the task is not tied to M1-M4.
task.briefHint: What the student must do. Markdown: # heading, - list, **bold**.
task.pointsHint: The marking aspects must add up to this.
task.graderModeHint: Single part, assembly, or practice with partial credit.
task.densityHint: Used for the mass check. Steel = 7850.
task.tolerancesHelp: How far a student's model may differ from the answer and still pass, in percent. Empty = the grader's default, shown in grey.
task.tolerancesHint: Tune these with "Grade a sample" before you publish.

tasks.emptyBody: Add the first task. Students see tasks in this order.
tasks.aspectCount: {count, plural, =0 {No aspects} one {# aspect} other {# aspects}}
tasks.deleteBody: The task, its files list and its marking aspects are removed. This cannot be undone. A task that students already answered cannot be deleted.

attachments.title: Files for students
attachments.help: Brief PDFs, drawings, images and given part files. Every signed-in student can download them, so never put an answer file here.
attachments.label: Label
attachments.saveReminder: Save the task to keep file changes.
attachments.saveFirst: Save the task first, then add its files.

aspects.title: Marking aspects
aspects.help: Each aspect is one thing that earns points. Measurement: full points or zero (unless a partial rule is set). Judgement: the trainer scores 0-3 and the points follow.
aspects.standardDone: STEP checks added. Adjust their points if needed.
aspects.checkKeyHint: Which grader check marks it. part:<name> = one named part of an assembly.
aspects.partialHint: Off = all or nothing (the competition rule). On = the grader's points count.
aspects.partialRuleHint: Any JSON object turns partial marks on. Students never see it.
aspects.judgementNote: The trainer scores this 0-3: 0 below industry standard, 1 meets it, 2 meets and partly exceeds, 3 wholly exceeds.
aspects.hintHint: Shown when the aspect is not passed. Explain the rule, never the answer.
aspects.rubricNote: Aspects marked "From the rubric" follow the rubric. Edit them in the rubric editor above.
aspects.sumOk: Aspects add up to {sum} of {max} points.
aspects.sumMismatch: Aspects add up to {sum}, but the task is worth {max} points. Make them equal before publishing.
aspects.emptyBody: Add the things this task is marked on.
aspects.emptyAuto: Add the 4 STEP checks in one click, or add aspects one by one.
aspects.deleteBody: Its points leave the task. This cannot be undone. An aspect that already has student results cannot be deleted.

reference.title: Reference data from the answer file
reference.help: Upload the answer STEP. The grader measures it (volume, surface area, mass, principal moments) and those numbers become the answer. The file goes to a staff-only folder.
reference.extracted: Measured. Check the numbers, then save them as the answer.
reference.namePartsHint: Names help trainers and become checks like part:Base. Letters, numbers, spaces, dots, dashes. Empty = keep the name shown.
reference.savedBody: Student files are now checked against these numbers. Try "Grade a sample" next.
reference.replaceNote: Saving replaces the answer data saved before.
reference.notConfiguredTitle: The STEP grader is not set up
reference.notConfiguredBody: Reference data needs the grader service (GRADER_URL and GRADER_SECRET). Until it is set up, students' STEP files get a basic check only.

sample.title: Grade a sample
sample.help: Upload any STEP to see the score and the feedback a student would get with the saved answer data and tolerances. Nothing is saved and the file is deleted afterwards.
sample.notConfigured: The STEP grader is not set up, so samples cannot be graded yet.
sample.needReference: Save the answer data first, then grade a sample.
sample.nothingSaved: This was a sample only: nothing was saved.

rubric.title: Drawing rubric
rubric.help: Each item becomes a marking aspect. AI items get an AI first pass that a trainer confirms; trainer items are checked by the trainer only. First and third angle projection are both accepted.
rubric.defaultBody: The current items are replaced by the default rubric for this drawing type. Nothing is saved until you press Save rubric.
rubric.emptyBody: Load the default rubric or add items one by one.
rubric.hintHint: Explain the rule, never the answer.
rubric.requiredHint: For items like GD&T or surface texture.
rubric.idHint: Small letters, numbers and _ . Used as rubric:<id>. Cannot change after saving.
rubric.aiGuidanceHint: Only the AI reads this. Students never see it.
rubric.idProblem: Each item needs a different ID made of small letters, numbers and _.
rubric.textProblem: Every item needs English and Arabic text and points.
rubric.fixFirst: Fix the items marked above first.
rubric.savedBody: Its marking aspects were updated to match.

package.title: Module package: expected files
package.intro: Students upload one ZIP of their Results folder. After upload we check the required folders and, per task, the expected files by name pattern.
package.foldersHelp: The eight folders of the competition Results structure. A missing required folder shows a warning to the student.
package.patternsHint: Folder / file name. * = any text, ? = one character. Example: Parts and Assemblies/Part_03.*
package.requireStepHint: Warn when only native CAD files (.ipt, .iam, .f3d) are found, because those cannot be auto-checked.
package.noTasksBody: Add tasks first, then say which files each task expects.
package.fixFirst: Fix the patterns listed above first.
package.savedBody: New uploads are checked against them.

split.warnBody: Competitions give most marks to measurement (about 93% at EuroSkills). Consider turning some judgement into measurement aspects. This does not block publishing.

publish.blockedReason: Fix the items listed below first.
publish.blockedTitle: {count, plural, one {# thing to fix before publishing} other {# things to fix before publishing}}
publish.ready: Nothing is missing. You can publish.
publish.warningsTitle: Worth a look (does not block publishing)
publish.testPublishedBody: Students can now see and start it.
publish.testUnpublishedBody: Students can no longer start it. Attempts already made stay.
publish.testUnpublishBody: Students can no longer start it. Their past attempts and results stay.
publish.exercisePublishedBody: Students on this level can now try it.
publish.exerciseUnpublishedBody: Students no longer see it. Past attempts stay.
publish.exerciseUnpublishBody: Students no longer see it. Their past attempts stay.

issues.task_no_reference: it is auto-checked but has no answer data. Upload the answer STEP.
issues.task_no_rubric: it is a drawing task without a rubric or aspects.
issues.aspects_points_mismatch: its aspects add up to {sum}, but it is worth {max} points.
issues.no_expectations: Module package test without expected files. Add them below.
issues.task_no_expectation: no expected files in the module package.
issues.bad_expectation: this expected file pattern is not valid:
issues.judgement_high: Judgement is {percent}% of the points (more than 20%).
issues.task_no_aspects: no marking aspects, so the grader's own score is used.
issues.pass_mark: The pass mark must be between 0 and 100.

errors.graderCode: The grader could not read the file ({code}). Check that it is a valid STEP export, then try again.
errors.has_results: Students already have results for this, so it cannot be deleted. Unpublish instead.
errors.blocked: Publishing is blocked. Fix the items in the list first.
errors.grader_not_configured: The STEP grader is not set up yet (GRADER_URL and GRADER_SECRET).
errors.grader_failed: The grader did not answer. Try again in a minute.
errors.file_missing: We couldn't find the uploaded file. Upload it again.
errors.incomplete: The measured data is incomplete (volume, area and moments are needed). Try another export.
errors.part_names: Part names must be different and use letters, numbers, spaces, dots or dashes.
errors.path: The file is not in the right folder. Upload it again from this page.
errors.texts: Every rubric item needs English and Arabic text.
errors.items: Some rubric items are not valid. Check their IDs and points.
errors.skill_area: Choose a skill area and save it first.
errors.sync: The rubric was saved, but its aspects could not be updated. Run migration 0082, then save again.
errors.download_failed: The grader could not download the sample. Upload it again.
errors.grader_error: The grader returned an error. Try again in a minute.
errors.not_configured: The STEP grader is not set up yet.
errors.unavailable: This is not available right now. Try again later.
